playtest.label: Playtest (recommended first)
playtest.description: Best balance of quality, time, VRAM. Use this for the first full inject and walk around in-game.

quality.label: Quality / 1440p-4K pop
quality.description: Heavier world detail. Use after playtest looks good and you want more sharpness up close.

balanced.label: Balanced (softer sharpen)
balanced.description: Same 1024 target as playtest but ultramix model — less harsh than ultrasharp on noisy materials.

legacy1440.label: Long edge 1440
legacy1440.description: Odd size (not 1024/2048). Kept if you already scanned with target 1440 and want consistency.

sharp.label: Max sharp (experimental)
sharp.description: Ultrasharp at 1024 — can look crispy or noisy. Prefer high-fidelity for world albedos.

fast.label: Fast (lite model)
fast.description: upscayl-lite at 1024. Measured ~2.6x faster than high-fidelity with visibly softer detail. Good for a first full-world pass.
